app.title: AirPlop
app.tagline: Instant cross-platform P2P file & text transfer
discovery.emptyTitle: Open AirPlop on other devices to send files
discovery.emptyHint: Devices on the same Wi-Fi appear automatically. Use Pair Device or Public Room for different networks.
discovery.dropHint: Drop files anywhere or click a device to send
peer.clickToSend: Click to send files or right-click for text
modal.sendTextPlaceholder: Type or paste text, links, or code snippets...
modal.pairDesc: Pair devices permanently across any network using a 6-digit code or QR code.
modal.pairCodeLabel: Enter this code on your other device:
modal.publicRoomDesc: Create or join a temporary 5-letter room to share files over the Internet.
modal.aboutDesc: AirPlop transfers files directly peer-to-peer using WebRTC with end-to-end browser encryption. No files are stored on any server.
modal.aboutShortcuts: Shortcuts: Ctrl+V to paste files/text • Ctrl+Enter to send • Esc to close
toast.pairRateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait 10 seconds.
toast.roomInvalid: Public room not found or invalid code.
toast.fileSelected: Select a target device to send your files.
